claimRequirements: wallet appears in or is independently proven from the verified legacy snapshot source
fresh Solana wallet ownership challenge is signed
wallet is not a Worldz project/system/distribution/liquidity/program/funding vault
duplicate identity and linked-wallet review is complete
linked verified wallets are aggregated to one claimant identity before weighting
claim record is human-approved or passes the approved automated proof policy

weighting.note: The 2.5M PNEX pool is not pre-paid to the old 216-wallet REVIVE candidate ledger. Entitlements are calculated from verified claimants.

claimWindow.rule: No automatic expiry or confiscation is invented. Any future close/expiry requires a separately disclosed governed policy.
